about: 10CL016 M9K port-A mode bits (offline; rom2: zero-content builds of 7 layouts at X13_Y10 and X25_Y20). Cells [frame offset from F[X] (m9kpatch.F), byte offset from lutpos.ROW[Y].low, plane offset from ROW[Y].plane]; identical at both sites. One-hot width code; x36 (36x256) sets none of them. 9x512 uses the x18 code, as its content layout does (m9kpatch.LAYOUTS). 'not_x36' bits are set for every layout except 36x256. Other layout-dependent bits are routing of the differing address/data lines. Port B and RAM write modes not studied.
